metadata.question: In 2021, did the Antarctic ozone hole reach a size of 18 million square kilometers?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Copernicus Sentinel-5P OFFL O3 data (ozone column) - Focus on Antarctic region (Southern Hemisphere, high latitudes) - Date: September-October 2021 (typical ozone hole peak season) - The ozone hole is defined by total ozone column < 220 Dobson Units 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify pixels where ozone < 220 DU (ozone hole definition) - Calculate the total area of such pixels - No cloud masking needed for atmospheric data 3. Logic: - Calculate area of ozone hole by counting pixels < 220 DU - Compare to 18 million km² - Valid zero: If hole exists but is smaller - C1: If no Sentinel-5P data available - C2: If no valid ozone measurements after processing - C3: If calculation fails or produces invalid result - A: If hole >= 18 million km² - B: If hole < 18 million km² ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Antarctic region (south of 60°S) const antarctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]] ); // 2. Get Sentinel-5P ozone data for September-October 2021 (peak ozone hole season) const ozoneCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') .filterDate('2021-09-01', '2021-10-31') .filterBounds(antarctic) .select('O3_column_number_density'); const colSize = ozoneCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No Sentinel-5P ozone data available for 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate mean ozone for the period const meanOzone = ozoneCol.mean(); // 4. Convert to Dobson Units (DU): 1 DU = 2.687e16 molecules/cm² // S5P provides mol/m² -> convert to DU const ozoneDU = meanOzone.multiply(2241.15); // conversion factor // 5. Create mask for ozone hole (< 220 DU) const ozoneHoleMask = ozoneDU.lt(220); // 6. Calculate area of ozone hole const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const ozoneHoleArea = pixelArea.updateMask(ozoneHoleMask); const areaResult = ozoneHoleArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('area'); const areaKm2 = ee.Number(areaResult).divide(1e6).getInfo(); // 7. Count valid pixels const pixelCount = ozoneHoleMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: antarctic, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('O3_column_number_density').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in ozone hole: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid ozone hole pixels detected."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (areaKm2 === null || isNaN(areaKm2)) { console.log("Calculation failed to produce valid area."); console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`Ozone hole area: ${areaKm2.toFixed(2)} million km²`); console.log(`Threshold: 18 million km²`); if (areaKm2 >= 18) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
